title: Hey, can you check my calendar?

messages.content: Hey, can you check my calendar?
Sure, I can check your calendar for today or a specific date. Which one would you like me to look at?
It looks like you don't have any events scheduled for today. Is there anything else I can help you with?
Can you add an event for today?
Of course! What would you like the event to be, and what time should it start and end?
Great! What would you like to call the event, and how long should it last?
Could you let me know the title of the event and its duration?
The title should be 'Test', and the duration should be one hour.
It seems there was an issue with booking the appointment. Could you please provide the time zone you're in, so I can set it correctly?
Uh, my time zone is Berlin.
I'm still having trouble scheduling the event. Let's try again with a different approach. Could you briefly describe how you generally add events to your calendar?
